fusions.name: Bolting Shoulder
fusions.desc: Bolts you up to 7 tiles into a target on your knuckles and shoulders it for 16 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Thumping Stamp
fusions.desc: Thumps the ground with both feet, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Knuckle Sprint
fusions.desc: Drops onto all fours and bolts: your movement speed rises 35% for 6 seconds, you finish 2 tiles from where you stood, and your dodge chance rises by 8% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Running Start
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
